title: The Last Song On The Train To Busan . . . (Part 3)
caption:
The selfish dad finally learned the lesson. Too late? 💔 Part 3 of 3, the ending. Comment hero or selfish!

#movierecap #traintobusan #zombie #kdrama #moviereview #recap #spoilerroom #fyp

segments.say: This little girl was one song away from being *shot* by the army.

segments.text: What should we do? Over. — Kill them, over.

segments.say: And the only reason she was still alive? Her dad, who had to *say goodbye*.
Last time, Big Mike died at the door. The passengers who locked them out were *gone*. Only a few were left.
Jack sat with Grace, Big Mike's pregnant wife. For the first time, he said *sorry*.
Then he looked at Lily and remembered what day it was.

segments.text: Today is your birthday. — I'll take you to your mom.

segments.say: He called her mom. No answer. He called again. The phone just kept *ringing*.
Then he went into the toilet, alone, and cried like a little *boy*.
Then the news said one thing. Busan was *safe*. The army was holding the city.

segments.text: Busan succeeds in defending the monsters.

segments.say: But the tracks ahead were *blocked*. The train had to stop at a wrecked station.
The driver said, find another engine. Then he went out to look.
The survivors walked through the yard to find an engine. Jack carried Lily. Tommy held Jenny's hand.
Tommy and Jenny ran for another train. But Jenny got bitten. And Tommy stayed with her until the *end*.
Then a burning train came crashing toward them. Thousands of zombies *poured* out of it.
Jack pulled Lily out of the fire, and ran for the one engine that still *worked*.
Jack climbed up last. Zombies grabbed his legs. Hundreds of hands, *pulling* him off.
He kicked free. The engine started *moving*. They made it.
But someone else was already hiding inside. *Mr. Stone*. And he was not human anymore.
He jumped on Lily. Jack pulled him off and fought him with *everything* he had.
He threw him off the train. Lily was safe. Then Jack looked down at his *hand*.
A bite. Fresh and *bleeding*.
His eyes started to turn. He showed Grace how to stop the engine. Then he looked at his daughter one last *time*.

segments.text: You'll be safe in Busan. — Dad, don't go! Don't go! I'm sorry!

segments.say: Remember what he told her at the start? Think *only* about yourself. Now he did the opposite.
He stepped to the back door, and *smiled* at her.
And in his last second, he saw the day she was born. Tiny baby Lily, in his *arms*.
Then he let go.
The engine stopped before a tunnel. Grace and Lily walked through it in the dark. *Alone*.
On the other side, army snipers were waiting. They could not tell if the two were *infected*.
The order came. Shoot. And Lily did the only thing she could think of. She *sang*.
The same song she wanted to sing for her dad, on her birthday. The song he *missed*.
Zombies can't sing. The soldier put down his gun. They were *saved*.
So tell me. Was Jack a *hero*, or a selfish man who changed too late? Comment hero or selfish.
